reviewer: independent Gong source and interpretation reviewer (/root/bench_gong)
scope: Independent scientific interpretation review of completed R007-R015 comparison outputs and comparison manifest after source benchmark freeze. Read-only aggregation checks; no new model inference, sequences, source searches, experimental labels, thresholds, or inclusion changes.

provenance.repeat_comparison_note: The manifest transparently preserves the earlier comparison run in previous_runs; frozen master and row-level R007/R008 hashes are unchanged. The rerun adds descriptive summaries without source relabeling.

interpretation: The primary denominator is 23 exact existing model-covered variants with at least one eligible in-scope positive assay, not all 40 positive variants, all 53 positive assay rows, or all 726 model-covered benchmark variants.
The all-mechanism positive denominator additionally contains NPNT splicing. Its model-negative result is not an enhancer/H3K27me3 false negative.
Label-specific unique counts in study/mechanism/locus summaries overlap when a variant has different labels in different contexts; they must not be summed as a partition.
The R015 unique-state partition correctly restricts null to variants whose reported in-scope labels are all null and retains positive/null context heterogeneity as conflicting.
Missing results, failed or unknown QC, inaccessible outcomes, ambiguous contrasts and absent existing model sequences are not experimental nulls.
All 32 study/assay/context groups fail the locked full-panel metric gate. Omission of sensitivity, specificity, FPR, AUROC, AP and inferential intervals is appropriate.

independence_review: The study-level source-positive counts sum to 41, but there are only 40 unique in-scope positive variants because LIN2020_FAM13A repeats CASTALDI2019 rs2276936.
FAM13A and FAM13A_4q22 are source naming variants of the same biological locus, not independent locus replications.
Gong contributes 14 model-covered positive variants across five source-defined loci; its six assay contexts are not six independent panels of variants.

Repeated assays, promoter/orientation contexts, study follow-ups, linked variants and technical/biological replicate measurements must not be treated as independent variant-level validation replicates.
The global 1/23 fraction is a descriptive selected-case recovery count. Neither a pooled binomial confidence interval nor a pooled performance claim is justified.
Five Gong loci alone do not activate the bootstrap rule because the complete scored panel eligibility gate fails.

examples.explanation: Enhancer absolute delta approximately 0.199954 passes the fixed delta threshold, but region score approximately 0.568677 is below 0.643623; no enhancer call. Both-gate call failure is not absence of any predicted allele difference.
Enhancer absolute delta approximately 0.124910 passes its fixed threshold, but region score approximately 0.164826 fails. H3K27me3 delta also passes while its region gate fails.
Region scores pass both model region gates, but enhancer absolute delta approximately 0.009025 and H3K27me3 absolute delta approximately 0.000118 fail the fixed indel delta gates.

frozen_call_recovery.interpretation: Most covered positive cases fail both fixed forward enhancer gates; low recovery is not solely the known reverse-complement loss. No outcome-driven threshold relaxation, orientation selection or rescoring is warranted.

interpretation: The forward call is enhancer-only. Reverse complement preserves a positive enhancer ALT-minus-REF sign and passes the region gate, but falls below the unchanged delta cutoff.
This is a cutoff-crossing loss, not an allelic activity direction reversal, and is not rescued by an H3K27me3 call.
It is the sole recovered variant among the 23 model-covered in-scope positive cases and therefore is not representative evidence of broad positive recovery.

It is also the sole forward-only case among those 23, while 22 are negative in both orientations. The small selected series cannot establish how common this behavior is among true functional variants generally.

Across all 726 model-covered benchmark variants there are 7 forward-only, 6 RC-only, 3 stable-both and 710 negative-both cases; this broader mixture contains many null, unavailable or ambiguous assay outcomes and is not a positive validation cohort.
Independent biological evidence for this locus does not repair model orientation instability or turn a pre-disclosed case into an untouched external test.

direction_review.interpretation: All six evaluable positive conventional-reporter variants agree with forward enhancer delta sign, but five fail fixed candidate call rules. This selected, locus-correlated six-variant observation is not independent validation of effect magnitude, sensitivity, or generalized direction accuracy. Gong statistical significance does not provide a documented higher-activity allele; GWAS effect direction must not substitute for reporter direction.

source_and_mechanism_limitations: Gong's 25 positive source variants produce 29 positive assay rows; all 25 also have null contexts. Null means no detected allelic effect under the reported study rule, not proof of biological inactivity.

Gong's design contains 1120 experimental variants; 1119 have S2 results, rs76419734 is absent for unknown reasons, and additional cells have missing statistical fields. The available 6671 explicit null rows do not establish a complete QC-accounted assayed denominator.

Gong exact harmonization retains 1099 exact source identities and excludes 21 unresolved identities from model comparison without changing their experimental labels; the experimentally positive rs57658727 remains source-identity unevaluable.

Gong's publisher S1 figure locus counts (GSTCD 492, EEFSEC 224, ADAM19 204, ADGRG6 108, HTR4 92) and enumerated source-range assignment counts (493, 224, 203, 109, 91) differ. Both are preserved; neither was forced to agree using outcomes.

Castaldi design/count tables and selected significant or reporter outcomes do not yield a complete per-context null panel. Design-only, ambiguous, and inaccessible results cannot become negative controls.

Regional CRISPR perturbation, chromatin contacts, GWAS/QTL associations and predicted TF binding remain context, not new exact allele-positive labels. Regional perturbation of a fragment does not validate its nominated nucleotide.

Splicing at NPNT is out of the primary regulatory-activity scope. Endogenous-expression editing and isolated TF-binding evidence remain partial-scope annotations unless a matching mechanism is established.
The H3K27me3 model is not a demonstrated functional silencer assay. H3K27me3 scores or their sign cannot be read as proof of transcriptional repression.
Any descriptive calls among reporter-null cases are assay disagreements, not a genomic false-positive rate. Forward calls in Castaldi cases with unavailable outcomes are not false positives.
plausible_alternative_explanations_not_d: Assay cell-type/state differences from frozen bulk-lung model context.
Episomal reporter or MPRA fragment, promoter, orientation, local sequence-background and chromatin-context differences from existing model inputs.
Assay power, multiple-testing requirements, per-cell QC or missing results; experimental nonsignificance does not imply biological inactivity.

The existing V1 sequence universe covers only 726 of 1710 exact benchmark variants and 23 of 40 primary positive variants, creating an ascertained intersection rather than a full external assay panel.
Broad transcriptional regulatory scope does not imply that the model and every reporter readout measure the same molecular mechanism.
required_reporting_language: Use 'descriptive recovery of model-covered positive cases' rather than sensitivity or independent validation performance.
State the positive source, exact-identity, existing-model-coverage and assay-context denominators separately.
State that no eligible complete scored assay panel was recovered, so AUROC/AP/FPR/sensitivity/specificity and inferential intervals are omitted under the locked protocol.
Keep biological evidence separate from candidate selection and model orientation robustness.
Mark this as descriptive V1 characterization and frozen external evaluation data, not an untouched V1 test.
No benchmark outcome may select future model architecture, thresholds, controls, seeds, orientation rules or retained runs; stop for investigator review.
